unit: first forecast per regulation mens senior regular league fixture
cell_bands: per-team 0,1,2,3,4+ pooled within league; shrink with prior amount of 380 fixtures plus one per cell
training_inputs: separate Poisson regression goals vs goals and genuine pre-target game xG; prior 4 matches at 1.3 and fixed 6 recent slots; gaps in days capped at 21
paired_issue_rule: equal probability mixture of refreshed Test and learned xG PMF (untrained recent-six xG diagnostic for other supported regular leagues). Keep proposed primary only if top exact score of one of the two experts. Otherwise choose mixture mode. Choose two remaining highest-probability alternatives across the whole joint PMF. No mandatory goals or score blacklist.
latest_replay: full latest 51; all same-version 40 compared, other 11 reported out of scope; data available by first comprehensive cutoff. Never use latest outcomes to tune.
holdout_limits: archived historical xG first-known time missing. Fixed 2025/26 used only for evaluation by this experiment; historical rather than prospective. Only source-timed totals qualify.
forward_cohort: all scheduled English Premier League fixtures within window
activation: research branch only; preserve active parameters and former freezes
